focusRecord.explanation: The child is cumulatively profitable and active in 11 of 12 windows, but it fails the frozen robust-breeder trade-density floor and the positive median-window net requirement. Quality and frontier admission never occur, so cell capacity and any competing member are not the binding exclusion.
